gloss: to choreograph; to create dance moves for

definitions.gloss: to choreograph; to create dance moves for
definitions.explanation: To design and assign dance movements or gestures for a performance.

examples.japanese: ⟦ダンス→ダンス：03856_dansu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{振|ふ}り{付|つ}ける。
⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な⟦{振付師|ふりつけし}→振付師：17990_furitsukeshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{曲|きょく}→曲：09881_kyoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{振|ふ}り→振り：03714_furi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}けた→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: A famous choreographer created the dance moves for this song.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学園祭|がくえんさい}→学園祭：19688_gakuensai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ダンス→ダンス：03856_dansu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{振|ふ}り{付|つ}け→振り付け：12880_furitsuke⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧3⟦{週間|しゅうかん}→週間：00988_shuukan⟧⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: It took three weeks to come up with the choreography for the school festival dance.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{振|ふ}り→振り：03714_furi⟧ (movement, gesture) and ⟦{付|つ}ける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧ (to attach). The noun form ⟦{振|ふ}り{付|つ}け→振り付け：12880_furitsuke⟧ (choreography) is very common and appears in various entertainment contexts from idol groups to musical theater. The person who choreographs is called a ⟦{振付師|ふりつけし}→振付師：17990_furitsukeshi⟧ (choreographer).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{振|ふ}り{付|つ}け→振り付け：12880_furitsuke⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧: to learn the choreography
- ⟦{振|ふ}り{付|つ}け→振り付け：12880_furitsuke⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧: to think up choreography
- ⟦{振付師|ふりつけし}→振付師：17990_furitsukeshi⟧: choreographer
- ⟦{振|ふ}り{付|つ}け→振り付け：12880_furitsuke⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧: the choreography is difficult

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{踊|おど}る→踊る：01250_odoru⟧: to dance — the general word for dancing itself, not choreographing
- ⟦{演出|えんしゅつ}→演出：04460_enshutsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to direct; to produce — broader term for stage/show direction that may include choreography
